aggregate.positive_evidence_scope: All relations in the document entries explicitly marked core are covered by a private whole-unit witness; this is not a quality-gate pass or a redefinition of the entire product summary goal.
aggregate.impossibility_scope: No universal impossibility proof is claimed for any document.

general_limits: Constructive evidence and universal impossibility are different claims; failure to find a selection is not proof that none exists.
Relevant meanings can be distributed across units, and a nearby proposal, task, general reference or date is not automatically equivalent to an adopted relation.
The natural-language source lock permits semantic grouping; unresolved implication and scope questions prevent categorical impossibility conclusions here.
No source-specific witness, unit selection, relation content or new per-category omission counts are included in this safe artifact.
limitations: This is a posthoc AI representation diagnostic on development material, not candidate-output evaluation, measured model performance, official evaluation, human review or a quality-gate change.

The existing judge has prior exposure to all159 source units, earlier source/label diagnosis, old actual extractions, six answers and their authorized source evidence, prior stored-label candidate summaries/titles, earlier generic code and injected project/role metadata. This is not pristine blind or fresh heldout.

Only the permitted locked source-judgments file was read in this phase. The optional source-only packet was unnecessary. No current actual labels, candidate/output packets, new design, performance, raw run, other split or answer judgment was additionally opened.
The reviewer configuration is the existing parent-registered gpt-6-astra/xhigh/fork-none role; this phase did not query runtime identity or invoke a separate model.

The representation question concerns whole original units, at most four, without shortening, merging unit fragments, adding bridging prose or substituting another source. Full context is used to interpret statements, but unavailable facts are not counted as expressed merely because the original document contains them.

The diagnostic maps existing entries explicitly marked core and their stated relations. It does not promote important/supporting details or every task into new universal requirements, nor declare them universally optional for the product or alter any prior coverage judgment.
The source lock is natural-language AI semantic guidance, explicitly allowing grouping and flexible summary granularity. It is not a fully formalized acceptance predicate or entailment calculus.

The constructive witness is positive evidence for all unambiguously explicit locked-core relations in that document, not a new passing summary, replacement output or proof that the complete product objective is exhausted by those relations.

The other documents have reviewed alternative evidence and unsuccessful four-unit selections, but no exhaustive proof over every semantic combination. They remain undetermined/likely insufficient, not confirmed impossible.
No minimum required unit count, per-relation score, new omission metric, new pass threshold, proposed cap increase, source reduction or rubric change is supplied.

No model, native, tokenizer, product runtime, tests, Git or product/source/input modification occurred. Processing was limited to permitted JSON reading, source-anchor reconstruction, hashing and creation of two new diagnostic artifacts.
All earlier source annotations, four-summary evaluations, candidate judgments, answer judgments and final quality/operational gates remain unchanged.
decision: Preserve the four-unit semantic selection design as unimplemented. Prioritize a prospective grounded compressed-summary contract because representation feasibility remains uncertain for three documents. This is a product-priority decision, not proof of universal impossibility or a changed quality gate.
